transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
My mood has been completely all over the place lately, and I just feel constantly revved up and on edge. It's like there's this motor inside me and I can't shut myself off, and I'm just so exhausted.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by 'all over the place' - are you experiencing extreme highs where you feel very happy or irritable, and then also lows where you feel sad or hopeless?

Yes, that's exactly it. I'll go from feeling on top of the world with this wired, angry energy where I'm snapping at everyone, to suddenly crashing into a heavy, dark feeling where I'm crying in the break room at work and feel completely drained. It's like I'm constantly swinging between those two extremes and I can't find any middle ground.
Can you estimate how often these extreme mood swings happen and how long each episode, whether it's the high or the low, typically lasts?

This constant, revved-up feeling and the wild mood swings have been going on nonstop for about a month now, ever since the pressure started for me to move back home. The heavy, dark crashes have actually been coming and going for about four months, but they've gotten a lot worse over the last few weeks.

Can you tell me if there have been any periods, even brief, where you've had two or more days where your mood was stable and not extremely high or low, or has it been a continuous fluctuation over the past month?

No, it's been a continuous roller coaster without any breaks at all. I haven't had even a couple of days where I felt normal or balanced. It's just been constant swinging back and forth, and I'm always either totally revved up or completely crashed.

Can you tell me if you've experienced any periods of at least two weeks where you only had depressive symptoms without any manic or hypomanic episodes, or have the depressive episodes always been immediately preceded or followed by these high-energy, irritable periods?

Yes, before this past month, I had periods of just being deeply depressed without any of the high energy. For about three months before the revved-up feelings started, I would just feel empty, guilty, and completely drained. The wired, irritable phases only began about a month ago when the family pressure started.

Can you confirm if the periods of depressive symptoms without manic or hypomanic episodes lasted for at least two weeks at any point, and were these episodes distinct from the current mixed state you're experiencing?

I'm not entirely sure about the exact timing of when those down periods started or if they were completely separate. Everything has just felt so incredibly overwhelming and mixed together lately that it's hard to keep it all straight.

Can you try to recall if there was ever a clear break or separation between your depressive episodes and the periods with high energy and irritability, or did they seem to blend together without distinct beginnings and ends?

They definitely seem to blend together and swing rapidly rather than having any clear breaks. I can swing from feeling on top of the world to suddenly crying in the break room, or drop straight from being highly revved up into a dark, hopeless crash. Even during the crashes, I still feel this constant, wired energy buzzing underneath.

Can you clarify if the depressive episodes you experienced before the high-energy periods started were distinct episodes that lasted for at least two weeks without any manic or hypomanic symptoms, or were they always intertwined with periods of high energy and irritability?

It's really hard to clearly distinguish them because everything has felt like a confusing blur lately. I'm not entirely sure if those earlier down periods were completely separate or if they were always mixed with those anxious, wired feelings.

Can you think back to before this past month and try to recall if you ever had a period where you felt consistently depressed without any high energy for at least two weeks, or were there always some symptoms of irritability or anxiety present even during those low periods?

Yes, over the last four months, I definitely had weeks-long periods of heavy, drained depression before this revved-up state started. During those low times, the high energy, racing thoughts, and strange things like hearing voices or seeing shadows would completely fade away, leaving me feeling just empty, numb, and guilty. Lately, though, it's all crashed together and gotten much more intense.

Can you confirm whether the depressive episodes that lasted for at least two weeks without manic or hypomanic symptoms occurred only before the onset of the high-energy periods, or if such distinct depressive episodes have also occurred during the past month of continuous mood swings?

Yes, those distinct low periods only happened in the first few months, when I would just feel completely empty and drained for weeks without any of the high energy. But over this past month, it's turned into a chaotic cycle where I'm constantly swinging back and forth between feeling extremely revved up and crashing into darkness.

To clarify, you've had distinct periods of depression lasting at least two weeks without high energy, but these were before the current month of continuous mood swings, and since then, you haven't had any two-week periods of just depression without the high-energy episodes, is that correct?

Yes, that's exactly right. The heavy, drained depression was coming and going for about four months, but this past month has been a non-stop, intense swing between being revved up and crashing. I haven't had any stretch of just depression since this chaos started.

Can you confirm if the distinct depressive episodes that lasted for at least two weeks without manic or hypomanic symptoms met the full criteria for a major depressive episode, including significant distress or impairment in social, occupational, or other areas of functioning?

Yes, those down times lasted for weeks where the high energy and racing thoughts completely disappeared, leaving me feeling entirely empty, exhausted, and guilty. It has completely ruined my daily life—I've been written up twice at work, my sister stopped inviting me to family events because of the tension, and I can't even keep up with basic chores like laundry or dishes.

Can you confirm if, during the past month of continuous mood swings, you have had any periods, even brief, where you experienced a predominantly manic or hypomanic episode without significant depressive symptoms, or have the depressive and manic/hypomanic symptoms been intertwined throughout?

They have been completely intertwined and swapping back and forth, sometimes even on the same day. I'll have stretches where I feel highly revved up—which is when the racing thoughts and hearing things happen—but then I'll suddenly crash into crying in the break room and feeling hopeless. It just feels like they are constantly mixed together rather than being separate, distinct periods.

Can you confirm if the current mixed state you're experiencing, with both depressive and manic/hypomanic symptoms, has lasted for at least two weeks without any distinct periods of pure mania, pure hypomania, or pure depression?

Yes, for this entire past month, it has been a constant, chaotic mix of both extremes without any distinct periods of just being manic or just being depressed. I've just been swinging rapidly between feeling wired and revved-up and crashing into dark, hopeless states, often on the very same day, for about four weeks now.

Can you confirm if the rapid cycling between manic/hypomanic and depressive episodes over the past month has involved at least four distinct episodes of some type, such as major depressive, manic, or hypomanic episodes, or has it been a more continuous fluctuation without clear episode boundaries?

It definitely feels like a continuous, exhausting fluctuation rather than distinct episodes with clear boundaries. Over this past month, I rapidly swing back and forth—sometimes even in the same day—from feeling wired and angry to crying and feeling hopeless. Before this chaotic month started, the heavier depression had just been coming and going on its own for about four months.

Can you confirm if the manic or hypomanic episodes you've experienced during the past month have typically lasted for less than two weeks before switching to a depressive episode, or have they sometimes lasted longer than two weeks?

I'm not really sure about the exact number of days or weeks each high or low phase has lasted because everything has been blurring together so much lately. I just know that this overall cycle of wild ups and downs has been going on continuously for about a month now.

Can you try to estimate the shortest time you've experienced a high-energy, manic or hypomanic episode during this past month before it switched to a depressive episode, even if it's hard to keep track of exact days?

I'm really not sure about the exact number of days or the shortest duration of those high-energy periods. My mood has been switching back and forth so rapidly and confusingly over the past month that I just can't keep track of it.
Can you try to recall if any of your high-energy episodes during the past month have lasted at least four consecutive days without switching to a depressive episode, or have they always been shorter?

I'm not entirely sure about the exact number of consecutive days because my mood has been so chaotic and swinging back and forth lately. But I can tell you that the revved-up, on-edge feeling has felt pretty constant over the past month.

Can you try to recall if there was ever a time during the past month when you had at least four consecutive days of feeling consistently high-energy, manic, or hypomanic without immediately switching to a depressive episode?

While I've felt constantly revved up and high-energy over this past month, it's hard to say if I've had four consecutive days of pure high energy without any crashes. My mood swings so rapidly—sometimes going from feeling on top of the world to crying on the same day—that it feels like a chaotic roller coaster rather than a steady, uninterrupted high.

Can you estimate if the longest period you've experienced a high-energy, manic, or hypomanic episode during this past month has lasted at least 7 consecutive days without switching to a depressive episode?

I'm not quite sure about the exact number of consecutive days I stayed in that high-energy state without any dips. My mood has been swinging back and forth so much lately that everything just feels like a blur.

Can you try to recall if any of your depressive episodes during the past month have lasted at least two weeks without any manic or hypomanic symptoms, or have they always been interrupted by high-energy periods?

I'm really not sure about the exact timing and I haven't kept track of how long those down periods lasted. Lately, my mood has just felt like a constant, confusing mix of ups and downs with no real separation.

Can you try to estimate if the rapid mood swings you're experiencing now are occurring within the same day, or are they happening over the course of a few days, with the high-energy periods and depressive episodes switching back and forth?

The mood swings definitely happen very rapidly within the same day, where I can go from feeling on top of the world and snapping at people to suddenly crying in the break room at work. While I still have those longer, heavy crashes of depression that have been coming and going over the last few months, my day-to-day life right now just feels like a constant, exhausting roller coaster of wired energy and sudden emotional drops.

Can you confirm if you have experienced any periods of abnormally elevated or irritable mood lasting at least 4 consecutive days, but less than 7 days, without switching to a depressive episode during the past month?

I'm not really sure about the exact number of consecutive days my mood was elevated or irritable. My mood has just been swinging back and forth so rapidly, though I've felt wired on and off throughout this past month.

Can you confirm if you have had at least one episode of abnormally elevated or irritable mood lasting at least 4 consecutive days, but less than 7 days, without switching to a depressive episode during the past month, which would help distinguish between the current diagnoses being considered?

I'm really not sure about the exact number of consecutive days or how long the elevated mood lasted without switching. My mood has been swinging back and forth so much lately that it's just too hard to keep track of the exact days.

Can you try to remember if there was any point in the past month where you had a clear period of high energy or irritability that lasted at least 4 days without immediately switching to a low, depressive episode, even if it's hard to pinpoint the exact days?

It's all a bit blurry, but yes, at the very beginning of this past month, there was a solid stretch of at least a couple of weeks where I felt constantly wired, hyperactive, and irritable without any of the low feelings. At the start, I was running on pure adrenaline—taking extra shifts, cleaning late at night, and constantly arguing with my family like a motor that wouldn't stop—and it was only later that I started crashing into those heavy, hopeless depressive states.

Can you confirm if the periods of elevated mood or irritability you've experienced have ever lasted for at least 7 consecutive days without switching to a depressive episode, which could help clarify the diagnosis?

While these intense, revved-up feelings have been going on for about a month, it's hard to say if I've had a full seven days in a row of just the high or irritable mood without any drops. I tend to swing back and forth really frequently, sometimes feeling on top of the world and then suddenly crying or crashing into a dark, hopeless mood.
Can you confirm if you have had at least one episode of abnormally elevated or irritable mood lasting at least 7 consecutive days without switching to a depressive episode during the past month?

It's really hard to confirm if I had a solid week of only being elevated without any crashes. My mood has just been swinging rapidly back and forth and feeling so chaotic over the past month that I can't say for sure.

Can you confirm if you've had any episodes of elevated mood or irritability lasting at least 7 consecutive days without switching to a depressive episode during the past month, which could help distinguish between the current diagnoses being considered?

I don't think I've had a solid seven days of only being elevated or irritable without any drops. My mood swings are just too rapid and unpredictable, often swinging from feeling on top of the world to crying in the break room or dropping into a dark, hopeless crash within the same day or every few days over this past month.

Can you confirm if you have experienced at least one episode of abnormally elevated or irritable mood that lasted at least 7 consecutive days, but less than 2 weeks, without switching to a depressive episode during the past month?

I can't confirm a continuous, uninterrupted week of just the high mood like that. My mood doesn't stay elevated or irritable for a solid week or two straight without changing; instead, I've been constantly swinging back and forth between feeling revved up and crashing into crying spells or depression.

Can you confirm if you've had any periods where you felt consistently elevated or irritable for at least 4 consecutive days but less than 7 days, without switching to a depressive episode, during the past month?

I'm really not sure about the exact number of consecutive days those periods last. My mood shifts so rapidly and chaotically that it's just too hard to track whether the elevated or irritable feelings lasted exactly four to six days at a time.
